notes: Access: direct fetch worked throughout (HTTP 200, no WAF/bot-block; robots.txt has standard Shopify disallows, none targeting bots/AI). Site is a Shopify store, primarily FURNITURE (excluded per scope) with a genuine Lighting/Mirrors/Decor tail. Count method: raw collections.json 'products_count' and cached collection counts are heavily inflated on this store (e.g. wall-lamps cached 56 vs 22 exact, table-lamps cached 260 vs 91 exact, hanging-lamps cached 324 vs 110 exact, wall-mirror cached 77 vs 18 exact) -- consistent with prior 'Shopify products_count is unreliable' finding, so every qty below is the EXACT unique-product-id count from exhaustive pagination of /collections/<handle>/products.json (limit=250, deduped by numeric id), cross-checked against a full site-wide /products.json crawl (793 unique live products total) and per-product product_type/title fields. Hierarchy decisions: (1) Lighting -- dropped the general 'Hanging Lamps' nav collection (site-verified exact 110) because it is a pure mixed roll-up: it is the union of Pendant Lamps(66)+Cluster Hanging Lamps(11)+Chandeliers(15)+Lanterns(6) plus ~22 further unclassified plain hanging lamps with no distinct site-reported qty of their own, so per 'mixed roll-ups: drop, don't pad' only the four named subtypes are listed. (2) Mirrors -- dropped the general 'Mirrors' collection (exact 25) since it is the exact union of Wall Mirrors(18)+Floor Mirrors(7)=25 with zero residue (id-set verified), so only the two specific subtypes are listed; also dropped 'mirror-with-wooden-frame' (1) as a redundant material-tag subset of Wall Mirrors. (3) Decor -- dropped 'Table Decor' (16, verified mixed: overlaps Tealight Holders/Candle Holders and even includes lamps like 'Esna Table Lamp With Bowl'/'Crater Bowl Cluster Chandelier'), 'Table Styling' (15, verified as the union of Vases+Candle Holders+Book Ends), 'Serveware' (3, union of Coasters+Bowls+one Cake Stand item), 'Wooden Decorative Items' (13, mixed material bucket spanning Book Ends/Bowls/Coasters/Mirror/Wall Shelf/Cheese Board/Clock), 'Minimalist Decor' (13, cross-category style tag), 'Wall Accents' (3, fully a subset of Wall Decor), and 'Kids Decor' (3, fully a subset of Vases+Wall Decor) -- all mixed roll-ups redundant with the specific categories already listed, confirmed via product-id overlap. (4) Book Ends and Bowls: the site's own dedicated collections under-tag (bookend collection shows 1, bowl collection shows 1) versus the true catalog; qty below (2 and 4 respectively) comes from an exhaustive full-catalog (793 products) product_type+title scan, manually reviewed to exclude false-title-matches (lamps/chandeliers whose titles merely contain 'bowl'). (5) Clocks, Photo Frames, Cake Stand have no dedicated collection page at all (one product each, confirmed via full-catalog scan and via empty /collections/clock, /collections/table-clock, /collections/cake-stand JSON) so link points directly to the product page. Excluded from scope and confirmed ABSENT after full-catalog scan: Glassware/drinkware (no distinct glass tableware type; /collections/glassware and /collections/glass both return empty), Sculptures/Figurines/Statues/Showpieces (0 title matches), Planters (0 matches), Trays (0 matches; /collections/tray empty), Urli/Diya (0 matches). Also excluded per scope: all Furniture (sofas, tables, beds, chairs, storage, TV units, etc. -- the bulk of the ~793-product catalog), Home Fragrance (none found), named design 'collections'/lines (Aarna, Aether, Andaman, Dastoori, Empire, Swoon, Utsaah, Yoho, Chalet, Heer, Lunora, Oralea, Vita Amalfi, Boheme, Doux Edit, Saanjh, etc. -- brand/collection-line listing pages, excluded regardless of contents), Holiday/festive promo collections (Diwali Home Lighting, Celebration Decor Edit, Illuminate this Season -- Holiday & Gift scope exclusion), and Wall Shelves (storage furniture, excluded). Duplicate-company check: no other Orange Tree / orangetree.in entry found in this batch; company is a distinct India-based furniture+decor DTC brand, not a duplicate of any other S.N. processed so far.
